title: Sewer Problems
description: Use this service request to report sewer problems. In case of a sewer emergency please call 311. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 10 business days.

observedQuestions.question: What is the Dallas Water Utilities account number?
If the service address is different than the address listed on the account, please provide the the service address:
What is the nature of your concern?
Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

detailsForm.completedContactPath: Account number, alternate address, and concern supplied; contact = No; Details Continue reached Contact

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about a nonemergency sewer problem.
actions.why: For a sewer problem that is not an emergency. The 311 request form asks for the Dallas Water Utilities account number, a description of the concern, and the service address when different from the account address.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Sewer Problems" requests is not the directed route for a sewer emergency. If the sewer problem is an emergency, then call 311 by phone instead of submitting a 311 request online.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Water Inquiries and Line Locates" > Choose "Sewer Problems"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Water Inquiries and Line Locates" > Choose "Sewer Problems"

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone about a sewer emergency.
actions.why: For a sewer emergency. The description for "Sewer Problems" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs emergency concerns to 311 by phone.
